newsitem.title: USA: CFTC eases floor broker/trader registration review.
newsitem.headline: CFTC eases floor broker/trader registration review.

text.p: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission on Thursday granted more self-regulatory powers to the National Futures Association, saying the NFA could approve the registration of any applicant for registration as a floor broker or floor trader without CFTC review.

In a notice published in the Federal Register, the agency said the NFA could also maintain the registration of any registered floor broker or trader who might be subject to statutory disqualification from registration without sending the cases to the CFTC for review.

The NFA previously had to give the CFTC a chance to object to granting of registration where an applicant for floor broker or trader had a disciplinary history including a potential statutory disqualification from registration.

The agency had allowed the NFA to perform registration processing functions for floor brokers and traders but it reserved the right to review registration cases where an applicant had a history of disciplinary actions.
Going forward, the NFA is required to provide the CFTC with quarterly reports with information about applicants cleared for registration.
